QuestInfo.name: Rise of the Alliance
QuestInfo.0: #p1013000# has heard something amazing, and started to make a fuss.
QuestInfo.1: #p1013000# is excited about the turn of events. With enough help, the Black Mage and his Black Wings won't stand a chance!
QuestInfo.2: Will you escort me to the continental conference?

0.0: Master! Master! I have heard something amazing! A person claiming to be the Empress of the Cygnus Knights has called for a continental conference. She's gathering all who oppose the Black Mage!
0.1: A continental conference?! And they want me to come?! That's so cool! I hope you don't feel overwhelmed when you meet all those important and powerful warriors. And don't feel bad if everybody's asking for my autograph, okay? We're going to make so many friends and beat up that stupid Black Mage!

yes.0: Hurry! The Empress is supposed to be at Ereve...

no.0: Master! This isn't really a decision, is it? We have to go! The more, the merrier, right?
